summary.text: Laura Wakim Chapman is a Republican member of the West Virginia State Senate, representing District 1, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, she has served since December 1, 2022, succeeding Owens Brown.

paragraphs.text: Laura Wakim Chapman was born in Wheeling, West Virginia, earned a B.A. from Middlebury College and a J.D. from the West Virginia University College of Law, and has worked as an attorney.
Chapman assumed office in the State Senate on December 1, 2022, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a constitutional lawyer and said her priorities included repairing roads, expanding broadband, economic development in the Northern Panhandle, and school security.
